item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's class is discussing the changes seen in children as they grow older. Which of the following statements about adolescence is incorrect ( )
A. Adolescence is the stage of human life between childhood and adulthood
B. Adolescence generally lasts from about 10 to 19 years of age
C. The body must already be reproductively mature before adolescence begins
D. Growth and reproductive maturity develop gradually during adolescence

options.A: Adolescence is the stage of human life between childhood and adulthood
options.B: Adolescence generally lasts from about 10 to 19 years of age
options.C: The body must already be reproductively mature before adolescence begins
options.D: Growth and reproductive maturity develop gradually during adolescence
